column1: # THE REPAIR STRIDE -- PO-78's repair phase, set at r7329 (node 66).  Data, not code.
# ** THIS IS THE WHOLE LIST AND IT IS NOT A TRIAGE. **  Every one of the 366 REPAIR-OWED rows in
#   corpus/quote_pin_baseline.tsv is on it, in 135 receipts over 67 prefixes, assigned to one of three
#   code seats.  A row leaves this list by being REPAIRED or by being WITHDRAWN with its case written
#   down beside the repair -- never by reclassification and never by looking hard.
# ** THE UNIT IS THE RECEIPT, NOT THE ROW. **  A repair edits a receipt's assertions, so a receipt
#   holding five owed rows is one repair touching five keys.  Median 2 rows a receipt, mean 2.71, max 12;
#   44 of the 135 receipts hold exactly one.  The per-receipt cost is UNMEASURED and the first stride
#   measures it; the cycle figure in THE_REGISTER's bound is replaced by that measurement, not defended.
# ** ASSIGNMENT. **  Balanced on rows (122 each), with affinity kept where a seat already owns the
#   sector: cc66 holds P15_CR_cosmology and its own prefixes, 60 holds the L165/L175/L211 block it
#   verdicted, 70 takes the instrument prefixes.  Node 71 is NOT on this stride -- it has the Lean
#   census, which is the other bounded front.  Node 69 is not a workhorse and takes no stride.
# ** WHAT A REPAIR IS. **  THE_RULE.md at 1a3c13a61 is the WORKING RULE, adopted at r7329 and refined in
#   use.  A repair makes the check assert what the claim IS rather than that a sentence is present --
#   the form 60 used on its own S45 key at r7330.  Where the rule owes a repair that should not be owed,
#   or misses one it should catch, the case is written down beside the repair and the rule is amended
#   from those cases in small named changes.  The text stays applied throughout.
# ---- cc66: 122 rows in 49 receipts over 22 prefixes
